scene: Inside the breezy pavilion, three marked exits lead to new transit routes.
picture: Flat side view inside the lacquered tea pavilion. Through the open archway far left floats a docked river barge. The woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands centre on polished floorboards. To the right sits a yellow glass-roofed trolley at a platform, and far right stands a brass spiral lift.
shown: A moored river barge with striped canopy waiting through an open archway far left
A glass-roofed yellow trolley idling at an indoor station platform on the right
A brass spiral lift with an open latticed gate standing far right
